name: Zip Pull
summary: A stitched denim download button whose brass zip slides open as the file arrives, then pops it out
about: Zip Pull is a denim pouch with a real brass zip along the top. Press it and the pull tab flips over, the slider runs across with progress while the teeth part in a soft V and a warm lining shows through. At the end the file pops out of the open zip with brass sparks and a tick, then slides home as the zip closes.
how: Press the pouch (or focus it and press Enter or Space) to start the download.
The tab flips, the slider travels with the progress and the teeth open behind it; the label shows MB and speed.
Press again while it runs to stop: the zip closes back up.
When done the file pops out with sparks and a tick, then the pouch zips shut and resets by itself.
